audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud thud of a car door closing. Male Voice 1 immediately speaks with a high-pitched, excited, and slightly nasal tone. Upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM with a strong kick drum starts. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. Male Voice 1's tone shifts to comedic distress, accompanied by a canned laughter track and a 'boing' cartoon sound. (3) A digital warning chime rings clearly. Male Voice 1 sighs loudly. The BGM tempo remains steady but ducking slightly under the speech. (4) Background texture shifts to an indoor garage atmosphere with subtle echo. Male Voice 2 (deeper, more professional timbre) enters. (5) Frequent metallic clinking and percussive thuds of tools being moved are layered over the dialogue. (6) A high-frequency whirring sound of an electric screwdriver occurs during a montage. (7) The BGM swells during a fast-paced editing sequence with multiple sharp 'pop' and 'hit' SFX. (8) Final segment features continuous conversational overlap between the two male voices with consistent BGM and occasional comic SFX cues.
